limitations: Static source and VPK index audit only. Nothing copied into installed game, no optimizer executed, and no performance claim experimentally measured.
Repository cvarlist has no build identity/date in file. Its flags/defaults are useful exclusions, not authoritative current-build validation.
Absent names cannot conclusively be called removed without testing current build. Video storage keys need not have a same-named ConVar.
First/last duplicate resolution and startup gameinfo vs persisted video precedence are unverified; conflicting definitions are facts.
Cheat and replicated flags here do not establish ban consequences. No ban claim is made.
ResourceCompiler and Hammer subtree edits are tool/compiler-oriented; no runtime benefit for precompiled maps has been demonstrated.
Low latency, frame-rate throughput, audio latency, VRR behavior, input support, visibility and frame-time stability are different outcomes. An FPS-only win does not imply an overall competitive win.

featureInventory.installationMechanism: Manual whole gameinfo.gi replacement plus tail replacement of existing video.txt preserving device identity header

performanceClaims.status: author claim with no benchmark table, harness, machine roster, scene definition or raw capture files in repository

findings.evidence: README installation; gameinfo L62-93 and L550 onward; Essential Fixes/*.vpk
findings.finding: OptiLock changes engine project metadata and provides replacement assets; it is not a config-only baseline for the requested no-mod project.
findings.action: Do not install OptiLock VPKs or replace gameinfo.gi.

findings.finding: The recommended preset embeds a creator-specific addon mount: citadel/addons/profile_1788286995090_8lc3039pw_qollite.
findings.action: Preserve current shipped search paths and disallow custom mounts in this project.

findings.evidence: recommended preset: 634 scalar assignments, 544 unique names, 90 duplicated names; own cvarlist flags 110 unique names cheat
findings.finding: Hundreds of edits are not evidence of hundreds of valid performance wins. Many are unavailable through a normal multiplayer config path.
findings.action: Use an allowlist with current-build registration, type/range, flags, successful readback and measured value.

findings.finding: cl_async_usercmd_send is assigned true then false within the same block.
findings.action: Keep shipped network behavior; do not claim an async send win from this file.

findings.evidence: gameinfo L901 r_texture_stream_mip_bias 8; video L75 mip bias 4; README asset fix warning; issue 7
findings.finding: The preset asks for two different texture biases, and the author links bias above 4 to a Sinner's Sacrifice light fix asset. Its streaming pool is forced to 256 MB.
findings.action: Avoid bias above 4, do not assume 4 is safe on new assets, and preserve adaptive texture budgeting until a trace demonstrates a bottleneck.

findings.finding: Particle limits, fallback threshold zero, skipped post-simulation, suppressed cable rendering and particle time scale 1.1 may remove or change effect cues.
findings.action: Keep particle timescale 1 and ability telegraphs; isolate native quality reduction and validate heroes/abilities before stronger cuts.

findings.evidence: recommended gameinfo L1007 and L1017 cl_fasttempentcollision 999999; L849 and L1011 anim_decode_forcewritealltransforms true; own cvarlist defaults 5 and false
findings.finding: Some values appear to request additional work rather than eliminate it. Engine implementations are unavailable, so their claimed performance rationale is unsupported.
findings.action: Exclude speculative collision, bone, IK, AI and simulation changes.

findings.evidence: recommended gameinfo L789 and L877; own cvarlist snd_mixahead default 0.001
findings.finding: snd_mixahead 0.05 changes buffering from nominal 1 ms to 50 ms, which is an audio latency tradeoff. Other audio changes remove mastering, DSP or occlusion and change reflection threads.
findings.action: Preserve audio until CPU trace identifies it as a bottleneck and latency/directional cues are validated.

findings.finding: r_aspectratio 2.15 plus hero FOV 100 alters camera preference and potentially scene load; it is not a generic FPS optimization.
findings.action: Preserve user FOV/aspect ratio unless deliberately tuning it.

findings.finding: Unfocused sleep is removed while Panorama limits are forced to 15 and fps_max_ui remains 120, creating inconsistent pacing policy.
findings.action: Use explicit game cap, responsive UI cap and background sleep; compare throughput separately from stable play.

findings.evidence: gameinfo L1201 and issue 9; raw keyboard L683 and issue 10
findings.finding: Steam Input is disabled, and forced input changes have user-reported controller/remap regressions.
findings.action: Preserve input handling by default. Keyboard-only disabling is a separate opt-in experiment with measured impact.

findings.evidence: own cvarlist identifies mat_set_shader_quality, enable_priority_boost, cl_physics_highlight_active, cl_removedecals as cmd
findings.finding: Four command names appear as scalar ConVar definitions in recommended gameinfo.
findings.action: Do not translate them as normal persistent settings; omit debug commands.

findings.evidence: 31 names absent in own cvarlist; r_lod, m_rawinput, threadpool_thread_limit, r_particle_parallel_simulation, r_particle_batch_simulate
findings.finding: Several common Source 1 or speculative names have no registration evidence in the supplied dump.
findings.action: Reject absent names pending current build discovery rather than reproduce tweak folklore.

findings.evidence: ResourceCompiler L286 onward; Hammer L231 onward; Memory L1364 onward
findings.finding: Compiler/editor options and memory estimate values of 1 MB have no demonstrated effect on gameplay performance.
